newsitem.title: USA: FORE Systems says suit is without merit.
newsitem.headline: FORE Systems says suit is without merit.

text.p: FORE Systems Inc on Tuesday defended itself against allegations it violated securities laws, saying a class action suit filed against the company was "without merit."

The allegations, stated in a July 11 filing in U.S. District Court in Pennsylvania, held that FORE Systems and some of its officers misstated the company's financial health and inflated the company's stock price.
"We believe that the allegations in the complaint are completely without merit and we intend to defend this action vigorously," said chief excutive Eric Cooper in a statement.
FORE Systems manufactures networking products based on asynchronous transfer mode technology.
